blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Indigenous conflict-resolution practices should be incorporated into peace education and dispute-resolution frameworks in Southeast Asia, experts and indigenous leaders said at an Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) conference hosted by the Philippines.
